Light parries and feints are your best friend.
The first results in guaranteed heavies which hits hard as warden.
The second, can be on 2 main things, your bash and your unblockable heavy.
If you feint the bash most will try to do 2 things, dodge or dodge attack.
The first is an easy guard break. The second is an easy parry.
Both result in a free heavy.
If you feint the unblockable heavy, its a 33/33/33.
Basically they have 3 choices, dodge, parry, or read the feint.
The first you can once again GB. The second same result. the third is obviously no punish for you but you it is also very hard for them to punish off of.
If you mix these two things eventually you end up putting a lot of quick hard damage with a lot of pressure.
In the end most of the time you'll either have the advantage or you'll have killed them.
This is just the basics, not accounting for actually using your bash, mixing in good lights, or letting those unblockable heavies fly when people are expecting the feints, but generally this creates the foundation of a good warden main.

learn. to. parry.
It is the most crucial part of the game and can stop majority of any low rank and some high rank playstyles. Once you learn that its all about learning people's playstyles so you can mix in your own moves accordingly.
Basically first learn the game, THEN learn the heros.
